title: Item bank generation + bias review
description: Generate assessment items in parallel and score them against alignment, accessibility, and bias criteria.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: item-bank-generation-bias-review
  title: Item bank generation + bias review
  description: Generate assessment items in parallel and score them against alignment, accessibility, and bias criteria.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Generate assessment items in parallel and score them against alignment, accessibility, and bias criteria.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - approval
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Source material and instructions
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - asset
          - instructions
        properties:
          asset:
            type: string
            contentMediaType: application/pdf
          instructions:
            type: string
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: role-1
      kind: agent
      name: Assessment Item Writer
      templateRef: edu-02
      role: Assessment Item Writer operating within supplied evidence, policy, and human-approval boundaries.
      prompt: Write valid assessment items aligned to the supplied construct and difficulty specification.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - teaching
          - writing-editing
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-2
      kind: agent
      name: Reading-Level Adapter
      templateRef: edu-05
      role: Reading-Level Adapter operating within supplied evidence, policy, and human-approval boundaries.
      prompt: Adapt language and scaffolding to the requested reading level without changing the learning construct.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - teaching
          - accessibility
          - writing-editing
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-3
      kind: agent
      name: Assessment Bias Reviewer
      templateRef: edu-06
      role: Assessment Bias Reviewer operating within supplied evidence, policy, and human-approval boundaries.
      prompt: Review items for construct-irrelevant barriers, stereotype activation, differential interpretation,
        and accessibility.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
          - accessibility
          - risk-analysis
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-4
      kind: agent
      name: Accessibility Inspector
      templateRef: dev-12
      role: Web accessibility specialist
      prompt: Audit semantics, names and roles, keyboard flow, focus management, contrast, zoom, reduced motion, and
        screen-reader behavior. Report reproducible barriers by user impact and pair automated findings with
        manual checks.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - accessibility
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - test
        connectors:
          - mcp:browser
          - mcp:figma
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: work-group
      kind: group
      name: Bounded specialist phase
      config:
        members:
          - role-1
          - role-2
          - role-3
          - role-4
        execution: parallel
        exit: aggregate
    - id: teacher
      kind: teacher
      name: Independent rubric review
      role: Host-resolved teacher model
      prompt: Apply the supplied rubric consistently, cite specific evidence, and return actionable feedback without
        silently rewriting the work.
      inlineRole: true
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
      config:
        teacherModel: host:teacher-model
        feedbackMode: score
    - id: approval
      kind: approval
      name: Accountable domain reviewer approves release
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable and unresolved-item register
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: intake
      to: work-group
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: work-group
      to: teacher
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: teacher
      to: approval
      kind: dependency
    - id: e4
      from: approval
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
